text: Vidi Intellix Vexi. I am Viv. Give me one piece, and we will build the next.

timing_variant.method: pitch-preserving time stretch plus bounded pause insertion

inflection_variant.voice_brief: An androgynous synthetic companion voice in a lower-mid register. Measured, precise diction; gentle human warmth; subtle electronic resonance; a trace of dry wit. Keep the same calm, curious timbre throughout. Speak slightly more slowly, with a small, natural beat between words, not a choppy or spelled-out delivery. Sound reflective, as if noticing each thought and choosing each word with purpose; let a faint moment of consideration precede the important words. Give 'Viv' a gentle warm rise, 'one piece' deliberate and clear stress, and 'next' a confident forward lift. Keep other words understated.
